jobs.description:
About the team 👥

Product Management at Performativ is responsible for deciding what we build, why we build it, and whether it delivers the intended result. We own the roadmap, shape the solution, make the trade-offs, and follow each product through to adoption.

We work directly with engineers and spend meaningful time with clients. There is no layer of process separating Product from the people building or using the platform.

We are a small team working across a large product surface: portfolio management, reporting, trading, compliance, client engagement, and the data and integrations that connect it all. Every roadmap decision comes with an opportunity cost. Our job is to make those decisions with conviction—and take responsibility for the outcome.

About the role 🎯

We are looking for a Domain Expert & Product Owner to help shape and own our wealth management platform and its underlying data layer.

This role sits at the intersection of financial-domain expertise, product management, and technology. You will help set product direction based on client needs, market understanding, and Performativ’s wider business goals. You will turn complex financial workflows into clear, reusable product capabilities that solve real problems without compromising the coherence of the platform.

The problems you might work on range from defining how Modified Dietz returns should be calculated and improving the performance of computational algorithms to reducing latency in trading workflows and designing interfaces used by thousands of advisers every day.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, and engineers to shape features before and during implementation. That means creating workflows, prototypes, product logic, and concrete examples—not simply writing requirements and handing them over.

You will also act as a key internal domain expert across wealth management, portfolio management, investment advice, trading, compliance, and related workflows. You will support commercial and customer-facing teams when specialist product knowledge is required and work directly with clients to understand how new capabilities fit into their wider technology and operating environment.

You will own both the ultra visible and also the less visible, but equally important, parts of the platform, including reconciliation logic, corporate-action processing, valuations, and data quality. A central part of the job is distinguishing genuine product gaps from client-specific preferences or processes inherited from legacy systems.

You need enough technical depth to earn the trust of engineers and client architects, enough commercial judgement to understand the consequences of your decisions, and the confidence to challenge a request—even when there is revenue attached—if it would weaken the product.

The role is based in Copenhagen. We support relocation for the right candidate.

What you'll do 📈

• 
Shape product direction based on client needs, market developments, business priorities, and engineering capability.

• 
Translate complex financial and operational workflows into clear, reusable product solutions.

• 
Help own and prioritise the roadmap for Performativ’s Wealth Management Suite.

• 
Evaluate opportunities based on client value, product quality, business impact, and technical feasibility.

• 
Work closely with Product, Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, and engineers to shape features before and during implementation.

• 
Create workflows, prototypes, product logic, and concrete examples that help teams align around the problem and the proposed solution.

• 
Write clear specifications that Engineering can build from without repeatedly having to interpret the underlying intent.

• 
Join client meetings, deals, and technical discovery sessions, then translate what you learn into sound product decisions.

• 
Act as an internal domain expert and support customer-facing teams when specialist product or financial knowledge is required.

• 
Identify gaps and inconsistencies across the platform and improve the overall coherence of the product.

• 
Decide what we commit to, what we decline, and why - and communicate those decisions clearly.

• 
Work with Engineering to balance speed, cost, performance, and long-term architectural integrity.

• 
Follow features into production, measure adoption and outcomes, and be honest about what worked and what did not.

What we're looking for 🔍

• 
Substantial experience in asset management, wealth management, private banking, or a closely related financial domain. Ideally, experience from a middle-office, portfolio-management, investment-operations, advice, or trading environment.

• 
A good understanding of financial products, their underlying mathematical concepts, and their operational consequences.

• 
Experience or desire to own a meaningful product or process area. Not merely coordinating tasks or administering a backlog.

• 
The ability to understand how portfolio data moves through a financial institution and where operational or data-quality problems arise.

• 
Comfort working directly with engineers and discussing APIs, data models, system integrations, and technical trade-offs.

• 
A track record of turning vague, conflicting, or overly client-specific requirements into coherent product capabilities that were built and shipped.

• 
Strong product judgement and the confidence to challenge customers, executives, and engineers when necessary.

• 
The ability to explain complex topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• 
Clear and precise writing. Much of your influence in this role will come through written decisions, examples, and specifications.

• 
Comfort making decisions with incomplete information and taking responsibility for the result.

• 
A willingness to travel across Europe for client work.

Preferred experience ➕

• 
Experience with portfolio-management systems or related order, execution, custody, or investment-management platforms.

• 
At least five years of meaningful product-management experience.

• 
Familiarity with financial-services regulation, such as MiFID II, EMIR, or Dodd-Frank.

• 
Hands-on software-engineering experience or a strong technical background.

• 
A practical and ambitious view of how AI can improve both your own work and the products we build.

• 
Experience replacing an incumbent system within a regulated institution such as a wealth manager, bank, asset manager, or custodian.

• 
Experience working in a high-growth or rapidly changing business.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Real ownership from day one. You will own outcomes, not simply administer a backlog. There are very few layers between you and a decision.

• 
Work that reaches production quickly. We ship continuously, and your work can be in the hands of advisers and financial institutions within days rather than quarters.

• 
Colleagues who set a high bar. Our team includes people from Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon, and other ambitious organisations.

• 
The opportunity to grow through responsibility. People at Performativ take on meaningful scope quickly. If you demonstrate that you can carry it, we will give you more.

• 
Direct access to founders, clients, and the market. You will be part of the conversations in which important product and business decisions are made.

• 
An ambitious mandate. We are backed by leading venture and institutional investors and are building to become a European standard—not simply another regional alternative.

About Performativ 🚀

Much of wealth management still runs on software built for another era: batch files, overnight reconciliation, manually assembled reports, and disconnected systems. Advisers and operations teams spend too much of their time working around their technology rather than serving clients.

Performativ is replacing that infrastructure. We provide one platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, built around how modern wealth managers actually operate. Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond.

We have raised more than USD 23 million from international venture-capital firms and leading European institutional investors. Our ambition is straightforward: to become the system on which wealth management runs.

You can learn more about our product at performativ.com.

The bar 🔥

We are builders. We move quickly, speak plainly, and expect people to take responsibility for their work. Autonomy is the default, but it only works when paired with strong judgement, initiative, and follow-through.

Performativ offers unusual scope for someone who wants to take on real responsibility and build something that matters. In two years, you should be able to point to important parts of the product and say: “I built that.”

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

Sales Engineer (SE)Help Make Manufacturing the Most Secure Industry in the World

At Secomea, we are on a mission to make manufacturing the most secure industry in the world.

We are looking for a customer-focused Sales Engineer who can bridge the gap between complex technical environments and commercial success. In this role, you will partner closely with Sales and customers throughout the buying journey, helping prospects understand, validate, and successfully adopt Secomea's solutions.

You will play a critical role in technical discovery, solution design, Proofs of Concept (PoCs), and technical deal execution, ensuring customers have the confidence to choose Secomea as their trusted cybersecurity partner.

This is a highly customer-facing role where you will work closely with Sales, Implementation, Product, and technical teams to understand customer challenges, design the right technical solution, and help customers validate that Secomea is the right choice for their environment.

You will report to Jesper Sønderby Andersen, Senior Director of Global CSM, Professional and Implementation Services, Solution Architects.

About Secomea

Secomea is on a mission to make manufacturing the most secure industry in the world.

Trusted by thousands of industrial companies worldwide, we provide secure remote access and cybersecurity solutions that help manufacturers, machine builders, and infrastructure operators connect, monitor, and support critical equipment safely and efficiently.

Headquartered in Denmark and operating globally, Secomea combines deep industrial expertise with a strong cybersecurity focus. We are ambitious, customer-centric, and passionate about solving complex challenges for some of the world's most important industries.

Joining Secomea means becoming part of a growing international company where your ideas matter, your expertise is valued, and your work has a direct impact on customers around the globe.

Your Mission

As one of our Sales Engineers, your primary objective is to establish Secomea as the preferred technical solution and remove technical barriers throughout the sales process.

You will partner with Sales from opportunity qualification through discovery, solution design, technical validation, Proof of Concept execution, and deal closure.

A significant part of your role will involve leading and executing customer PoCs. You will define success criteria, design and configure solutions, coordinate technical evaluations, solve challenges, and ensure customers reach a clear and confident technical decision.

Your role is not simply to demonstrate technology. You will help customers understand how Secomea solves their specific challenges and deliver the confidence needed to move forward.

Key ResponsibilitiesTechnical Discovery & Solution Design

• 
Support Sales in qualifying opportunities and determining the appropriate level of technical engagement.

• 
Conduct technical discovery sessions to understand customer environments, challenges, security requirements, and success criteria.

• 
Design secure and scalable solution architectures aligned with customer OT, IT, networking, and cybersecurity environments.

• 
Identify technical risks early and develop mitigation strategies.

• 
Deliver tailored demonstrations that address each customer's unique needs and use cases.

• 
Translate technical capabilities into meaningful business outcomes and customer value.

Proof of Concept (PoC) Leadership

A key part of this role is planning and executing successful customer PoCs.

You will:

• 
Define scope, success criteria, timelines, responsibilities, and decision points.

• 
Configure and deploy Secomea solutions within customer environments.

• 
Collaborate directly with OT, IT, networking, and cybersecurity teams.

• 
Ensure agreed use cases and success criteria are validated.

• 
Troubleshoot technical issues and coordinate with Product, Support, R&D, and Implementation teams when required.

• 
Maintain momentum and proactively manage technical blockers and dependencies.

• 
Present findings and technical recommendations to customer stakeholders.

• 
Support Sales in converting successful technical validation into commercial success.

• 
Capture learnings and continuously improve technical playbooks, demonstrations, and future engagements.

Technical Deal Execution

• 
Own the technical solution strategy for assigned opportunities.

• 
Support RFIs and RFPs with clear and compelling technical responses.

• 
Develop solution architectures, technical proposals, and implementation recommendations.

• 
Support security reviews, technical due diligence, and customer audits.

• 
Address technical objections throughout the sales process.

• 
Position Secomea effectively against competing solutions.

• 
Build trusted relationships with customer technical teams and decision-makers.

• 
Ensure technical decision criteria are met and no unresolved blockers remain before deal closure.

Continuous Improvement

At Secomea, winning deals is important, but learning from them is equally valuable.

You will:

• 
Conduct win/loss reviews on relevant opportunities.

• 
Identify recurring objections, competitive challenges, and market trends.

• 
Maintain accurate technical opportunity data within Salesforce.

• 
Share customer and market insights with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing teams.

• 
Contribute to the continuous improvement of Sales Engineering processes, demonstrations, and technical positioning.

What You'll Need to Succeed

To succeed in this role, you will be able to:

• 
Understand complex technical environments across OT, IT, networking, and cybersecurity.

• 
Translate customer requirements into practical, scalable technical solutions.

• 
Lead structured discovery sessions and uncover business and technical needs.

• 
Manage complex Proofs of Concept involving multiple stakeholders.

• 
Troubleshoot technical issues methodically and effectively.

• 
Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• 
Build credibility with engineers, cybersecurity professionals, and technical decision-makers.

• 
Balance technical expertise with commercial awareness.

• 
Take ownership and drive customer engagements forward.

Required Qualifications

• 
Professional experience within Sales Engineering, Operational Technology (OT), Cybersecurity, or a similar technical customer-facing role.

• 
Experience working with enterprise customers and complex B2B sales cycles.

• 
Strong understanding of networking, infrastructure, cybersecurity, or industrial environments.

• 
Professional working proficiency in English and either French or German.

• 
Ability to confidently conduct customer meetings, workshops, technical discussions, and Proofs of Concept in English and either French or German.

Who Are You?

We are looking for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of technology, customer success, and commercial impact.

You are curious, analytical, and customer-focused. You enjoy solving complex challenges, communicating clearly, and helping customers make informed technical decisions.

We imagine you bring experience from one or more of the following areas:

• 
Sales Engineering / Pre-Sales

• 
Operational Technology (OT)

• 
Cybersecurity

Experience across multiple disciplines will be considered a significant advantage.

It Would Be a Strong Advantage If You Have

• 
Experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Pre-Sales Engineer, Solution Architect, Technical Consultant, or similar role.

• 
Experience planning and executing customer PoCs or technical pilots.

• 
Experience working with industrial customers, manufacturers, machine builders, or critical infrastructure.

• 
Strong presentation and demonstration skills.

• 
The ability to simplify complex technical concepts for different audiences.

• 
A strong customer-centric mindset and commercial understanding.

• 
Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Product, Support, and Implementation teams.

How We Think About Sales Engineering

At Secomea, Sales Engineering is not just about answering technical questions or delivering product demonstrations.

A great Sales Engineer helps move customers from:

Relevant → Secure → Validated → Justified → Closed

You help establish that:

• 
Secomea is relevant to the customer's challenges.

• 
The proposed architecture is secure and technically viable.

• 
The solution works within the customer's environment.

• 
Technical and business value are clearly understood.

• 
Risks and objections are proactively addressed.

• 
The customer is confident in selecting Secomea as their trusted partner.

Why Join Secomea

• 
Join a global cybersecurity company with ambitious growth plans.

• 
Work with some of the world's leading industrial companies and manufacturers.

• 
Influence strategic customer decisions and directly impact commercial success.

• 
Collaborate with talented colleagues across Sales, Product, Support, and Engineering.

• 
Be part of a culture built on trust, ownership, innovation, and continuous learning.

If you're passionate about cybersecurity, industrial technology, and helping customers solve real-world challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: AWS Cloud Architect - Lead the design of Norlys' enterprise cloud platform
jobs.description:
Location: Aarhus or Silkeborg

Do you want to take a leading role in building a modern AWS platform from the ground up? Could you see yourself shaping the architecture, governance and operating model that will enable teams across Norlys to succeed in the cloud? Then this might be your next challenge.

Be part of the platform journey at Norlys

You will join the Cloud Platforms team and work at the center of Norlys’ AWS journey, where the ambition is to build a robust enterprise platform that enables consistent workload deployment and operations across the organization. In this role, you will work closely with application teams, security specialists, network teams, solution architects, and external partners to assess workloads, map dependencies, and onboard applications successfully to AWS.

You will act as a trusted AWS advisor across the organization, balancing architectural direction with hands-on delivery and helping Norlys build the capabilities and operating model needed for managing our cloud platform.

Shape the foundation for cloud at scale

We are looking for a senior AWS Cloud Architect to lead the design and evolution of Norlys’ enterprise AWS platform and the core capabilities needed for long-term adoption across the organization. In this role, you will help establish a secure, scalable, automated, and cost-efficient cloud foundation that enables application teams to deploy and operate workloads consistently.

You will work across platform architecture, governance, networking, security, observability and automation, while also helping define the standards and operating model that make AWS usable and sustainable at enterprise scale.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Design and evolve Norlys’ enterprise AWS platform, including landing zones, secure connectivity and standardized workload environments.

• Define the AWS operating model and governance setup, including multi-account structure, Control Tower, policies and security guardrails aligned with CIS, NIS2, and ISO 27001.

• Build shared platform services for identity, security, logging, monitoring and observability to support enterprise adoption.

• Drive automation and reusable platform engineering through Infrastructure as Code, reference architectures and standardized patterns.

• Ensure the platform is secure, scalable, reliable and cost-efficient, including reporting, budgeting and FinOps optimization.

• Support cloud migration and modernization through workload assessments, dependency mapping, and target-state architecture.

• Maintain platform documentation and drive alignment across standards, architectural decisions, onboarding and cross-functional stakeholders.

Apply your technical depth where it matters most

We are looking for a senior AWS Cloud Architect with the technical depth to design enterprise-grade cloud foundations and the pragmatism to turn architectural decisions into working platform capabilities. Just as importantly, you take ownership, drive progress and know how to work across business and IT functions without losing technical precision. You are collaborative and pragmatic in your approach, comfortable leading architectural discussions, and equally comfortable contributing directly to implementation when needed.

We imagine that you:

• Have 5+ years of experience designing and building enterprise AWS platforms and landing zones at scale.

• Bring strong hands-on expertise across AWS networking, identity, security, governance, observability and core infrastructure services.

• Have proven experience with cloud migration, workload modernization and onboarding application and data teams to AWS.

• Are strong within Infrastructure as Code and automation, using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, CI/CD or similar technologies.

• Have excellent architectural judgment, stakeholder management and communication skills, and can translate business and technical requirements into practical cloud solutions.

Ready to make an impact?

If you have questions, please contact Prashanth Pattabiraman at mail: praspa@norlys.dk. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will take down the job posting once we’ve found the right candidate, so please send us your CV as soon as possible.

Diversity and inclusion are part of Norlys’ DNA and our core values: Community, Innovative Thinking & Responsibility.

We believe that a true community is inclusive, safe, and inspiring; that it is responsible to create space for diversity; and that we innovate best when we bring all competencies into play. Therefore, we encourage everyone to apply for the position, regardless of background.

Norlys er Danmarks største integrerede energi- og telekoncern med ca. 800.000 andelshavere, 3,5 millioner kunderelationer, 4.600 medarbejdere og over 100 år på bagen. Som andelsejet selskab ligger det dybt i vores DNA at tage ansvar for mere end os selv. Derfor leverer vi ikke bare fremtidssikrede løsninger til danske hjem og virksomheder. Vi arbejder målrettet for grøn og digital omstilling af hele vores samfund. Og brænder for at skabe fremskridt for både mennesker, lokalmiljø og klima. Vi håber, at du vil være med. For vi tror på, at fremtiden er så god, som vi gør den til. Sammen.

Opportunities for professional and personal development

jobs.occupation: Implementation Consultant with expertise in social services – Columna Cura
jobs.description:
Implementation Consultant with expertise in social services – Columna Cura

Do you know municipal case management in social services inside out – VUM, FFB, service catalogues, rates and citizens' co-payments – and would you like to help municipalities get the most out of their IT support for social services? Then seize this unique opportunity to put your professional insight to use in a company with high ambitions, and help our customers get the greatest value from Columna Cura!

Join a collaborative and ambitious team

As our new Implementation Consultant, you'll work with Columna Cura, our IT solution for the health and social care sector, which supports staff, citizens and relatives throughout the citizen's entire care journey. The solution is already live in 38 Danish municipalities, and we're growing in social services, where case management, service provision and collaboration between authority and provider place specific demands on how the system is configured and used.

You'll join the Cura Projects & Services team, made up of dedicated colleagues – consultants, solution architects, service developers and more.

The team's main responsibility is project and service delivery, and your tasks will include implementation projects, training and professional guidance on configuration.

Play a key role and contribute to Systematic's growth

As our new Implementation Consultant on Columna Cura, you'll play a key role in helping municipalities get off to a strong start with Cura in social services – and continue to get optimal value from the Cura product suite afterwards. You'll bridge the gap between the municipality's case management practices, providers' needs and the system's setup, translating assessments, service catalogues, rates and workflows between authority and provider into a well-functioning Cura setup.

Your insights from customer dialogue also feed into our product and service development.

Your key tasks will include:

• advising municipalities on how to configure Cura to support case management in social services, including VUM (the Adult Needs Assessment Method) and the process from assessment and decision to service delivery

• setting up and maintaining service catalogues (FFB – Denmark's Common Professional Concepts framework – and municipal services), rates and rules for citizens' co-payments in collaboration with the customer

• supporting collaboration between case workers and internal and external providers in Cura, including ordering, follow-up and billing of services

• training system administrators and super users to use and configure Cura

• producing and maintaining functional documentation that helps customers configure Cura to their needs

• taking part in tender responses for new customers

• working closely with your colleagues in Cura Projects & Services, Product Management and Domain Advisors, and feeding valuable customer insights from social services into our product development

You should expect around five travel days a month to customers in Denmark and Norway.

Put your social services expertise to use

Our new colleague knows social services inside out – either as a social worker with hands-on experience in case management or with providers, or as a system administrator or super user of Columna Cura or a similar IT solution for social services. As a Senior Front-End Engineer, you will co-own the front-end experience for Performativ's trading and analytics platform, building high-performance interfaces used by wealth managers and financial institutions. About the team 👥

The engineering team owns the platform that powers portfolio management, trading, analytics, reporting, compliance, and client engagement at Performativ. Front-end engineers work closely with backend engineers, product, and design to turn complex financial workflows into software that advisors can use every day.

The team ships continuously and gives engineers ownership over implementation decisions. On the front end, the current focus is scaling a Next.js and React architecture across increasingly sophisticated workflows while keeping performance, server and client boundaries, theming, and shared components under control.

About the role 🎯

We are looking for a Senior Front-End Engineer to co-own the quality, performance, and architecture of our trading and analytics interfaces. This role is responsible for building production UIs, shaping front-end architecture, and raising the standard of our shared component infrastructure.

You will work closely with backend engineering, product, and design to ship financial workflows from requirements through production. You will co-own the end-to-end front-end scope, including server and client boundaries, hydration strategy, state management, performance, multi-tenant theming, testing, and the component library used across the platform.

This role requires deep React and TypeScript expertise, strong architectural judgment, and the ability to turn complex financial workflows into fast, usable interfaces. You need to be comfortable making implementation decisions independently and shipping production software without management overhead.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together from our city-center office, with working from home possible when there is a good reason. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What you'll do 📈

• 
Build high-performance trading, analytics, and portfolio management interfaces used by wealth management professionals.

• 
Co-own front-end architecture across Next.js 15, React Server Components, TypeScript, and our shared application infrastructure.

• 
Define server and client boundaries, hydration strategies, and state patterns that keep the platform responsive as complexity grows.

• 
Scale our shared component library and multi-tenant theming across the platform.

• 
Improve runtime performance, bundle size, rendering behavior, and application responsiveness.

• 
Ship production features quickly while making architectural decisions that hold up as the product scales.

• 
Use AI coding agents where they improve engineering throughput while maintaining control over code quality and implementation decisions.

• 
Strengthen front-end testing and delivery across Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, and CI/CD workflows.

• 
Co-own implementation decisions from product outcome through production deployment.

What we're looking for 🔍

• 
Have built sophisticated production web applications with React and TypeScript and can structure front-end codebases that continue to work as product complexity grows.

• 
Understand modern React architecture, including React Server Components and the Next.js App Router, or can demonstrate the technical depth to become productive with them quickly.

• 
Have shipped production work using AI coding agents and understand where they improve engineering output and where direct engineering judgment is required.

• 
Have improved front-end performance through decisions around bundle size, hydration, rendering, data fetching, and runtime behavior.

• 
Are comfortable managing server state with TanStack Query and can make deliberate decisions about colocated state and client state libraries.

• 
Have built or extended component systems using tools such as Radix, shadcn/ui, or custom design systems.

• 
Understand usability, accessibility, and interaction design well enough to make sound UX decisions without treating design as somebody else's problem.

• 
Have shipped tested production software using tools such as Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

Preferred experience ➕

• 
Have worked on trading, investment management, portfolio analytics, or other data-intensive financial applications.

• 
Have worked with AG Grid or comparable data-grid infrastructure for complex datasets and interactions.

• 
Have worked in a pnpm and Turborepo monorepo with generated API types from OpenAPI specifications.

• 
Have designed front-end systems supporting multiple tenants, brands, or configurable themes.

• 
Have mentored engineers or raised engineering standards without moving away from hands-on development.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Work that reaches production fast. We ship weekly. Your work will be used by advisors and financial institutions within days, not quarters.

• 
Colleagues who set a high bar. Our team comes from Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, and Amazon. Standards are high. Politics are absent.

Career compression. People here take on scope in twelve months that takes five years elsewhere. If you can carry it, we will give it to you.

Direct access to founders, customers, and the market. You will sit in the rooms where decisions get made.

Backing from leading venture funds, and a mandate to become the European standard rather than a regional alternative.

Wealth management runs on software built for a different era. Batch files. Overnight reconciliation. Client reports assembled by hand. Advisors spend more time fighting their systems than advising clients. The industry has accepted this for thirty years.

We are replacing that layer. Performativ is one platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, and client engagement, built from the ground up for how wealth is actually managed today. Banks, family offices, and independent advisors across Europe run on it.

We are a scaleup, not a startup. The product is live, the customers are real, and the growth is ahead of plan. We intend to be the system European wealth management runs on. That is not positioning. It is the plan we are executing against.

Basico is recruiting a Senior Finance Business Partner on behalf of Circle K.

It’s a numbers game – and you’ve mastered it

· Work closely with the business to identify challenges and optimization opportunities.

· Analyze business performance and bring financial insights and recommendations to management.

· Improve and execute budgeting and forecasting processes within your area of responsibility, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and alignment with other areas.

· Analyze and explain developments in month-end figures.

· Build and review business cases.

· Communicate and present business cases and ad hoc analysis to management and other stakeholders.

Your business acumen makes you the preferred advisor

CI/CD & Reliability

• Proficiency in PostgreSQL and experience in configuring AI gateways for centralized AI governance

Soft Skills

Ideally you are a trusted technical leader who combines strong engineering expertise with clear thinking and a collaborative approach to drive sound decisions, communicate complex platform, security, and architecture topics in a business-friendly way, and foster team growth. Brings a proactive and curious mindset, with a passion for emerging AI technologies balanced by a pragmatic focus on execution and delivery.

The team works at the intersection of data science, machine learning, cloud engineering, and product development, collaborating closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Architects, and Product stakeholders.

You will report to the AI Platform Manager and serve as the senior technical voice that shapes how the platform is designed, secured, and evolved — influencing both what gets built and how it gets built.

Did we get your attention?

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

Icing on the cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials.
